name: The Resolute
text: A Fleet tender at anchor, running lights low: the Resolute, your old ship. Her chief is on the open band, asking anyone for spares. The crate you walked off with would have seen her right.

choices.label: Pay for her spares
choices.result: The chief knows your voice and doesn't say so. He logs the money as a gift from a friend of the Fleet, which the Provost will have to read.

choices.label: Keep flying
choices.result: Someone else will see her right. Probably.
